# AuraSine

> LiFePO4 (Lithium Iron Phosphate) pure sine wave inverter and battery manufacturer, serving the Indian market.

AuraSine manufactures:
- Standalone LiFePO4 battery packs: 100Ah (12V), 200Ah (12V, 24V), 500Ah (12V, 24V, 48V)
- Complete pure sine wave inverter systems with Bluetooth app monitoring: 1500VA, 2500VA, 5000VA

Key facts:
- Pure sine wave output — same clean waveform as grid electricity, unlike cheaper modified square wave inverters.
- LiFePO4 vs lead-acid: charges in 2-3 hours (vs 8-10), lasts 8-10 years (vs 3-5), sealed and maintenance-free.
- Warranty: 5 years standard, rated for 3000+ charge cycles.
- Pricing is shared on enquiry, not published.
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +91 63763 09311, email yogeshdhaka311@gmail.com.
